_note: Framework catalogs the ingester can map against, by id. Each entry is pinned by sha256: a catalog whose bytes differ from the pin is refused, so a changed upstream file is a deliberate re-pin, never a silent swap. 'path' = vendored in this directory; 'url' only = fetched at run time and cached under <home>/catalogs/. VCRI hosting framework/<id>/<version>.oscal.json is the target (DESIGN, 'Modularity'); until then the url is the publisher's. Provenance and licenses: SOURCE.md.
